title: Continual pretraining Prostate MRI ViT Encoder for task alignment
abstract: arXiv:2610.20217v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Building foundation models for MRI has emerged as a promising direction for advancing medical image analysis and improving accessibility of task specific models. Existing approaches primarily focus on effective pretraining strategies and evaluating their performance across diverse downstream tasks. While these methods show performance gains, limited attention has been given to understanding task alignment between pretraining and downstream objectives. Unlike language models, where the two stages are naturally aligned, such alignment is less evident in vision based applications. Motivated by this gap, we explore continual pretraining. Specifically, continually pretraining a pretrained ViT encoder using Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) on a prostate segmentation task to enhance task alignment and downstream performance. We further perform layer-wise representational analysis using Centered Kernel Alignment (CKA) to assess representational shif

translated_title: 持续预训练前列腺MRI ViT编码器以实现任务对齐
translated_abstract: 构建MRI基础模型已成为推进医学图像分析和提高任务特定模型可及性的一个有前景的方向。现有方法主要关注有效的预训练策略，以及在不同下游任务上评估其性能。虽然这些方法展现了性能提升，但对理解预训练与下游目标之间任务对齐的关注却有限。与语言模型中两个阶段天然对齐不同，这种对齐在基于视觉的应用中并不明显。受此空白的启发，我们探索了持续预训练。具体而言，在前列腺分割任务上使用低秩适应对预训练的ViT编码器进行持续预训练，以增强任务对齐和下游性能。我们进一步使用中心化核对齐进行逐层表征分析，以评估表征变化。
tldr: 该论文提出利用LoRA在前列腺分割任务上对预训练的ViT编码器进行持续预训练，以增强预训练与下游任务之间的对齐，并通过CKA逐层表征分析评估表征变化。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes continual pretraining of a pretrained ViT encoder with LoRA on prostate segmentation to enhance task alignment between pretraining and downstream objectives, with CKA-based layer-wise analysis to assess representational shifts.
